title: Add dedicated chat PRD review popup before submission
specification:
# PRD: Add dedicated chat PRD review popup before submission

Priority: medium

## Problem
Chat-generated PRD proposals currently load into the existing Advanced tab PRD form, which is less visible and less guided than a dedicated review flow. Managers want a visual confirmation step before submission, with an obvious way to close or go back.

## Goal
Present chat-generated PRD proposals in a dedicated popup review flow that visually summarizes the proposal and requires explicit submit or dismissal.

## Requirements
- When a repo chat response includes a `prdProposal`, open or offer a dedicated review popup instead of relying on the Advanced tab draft panel alone.
- Show the proposal in a visual summary layout, including title, problem, goal, requirements, acceptance criteria, verification, and priority when present.
- Include a primary `Submit` action that queues the PRD through the existing submission path.
- Include a secondary `Back` or `Return` action that exits the popup without submitting and preserves the draft for later review.
- Allow the popup to be closed directly without submitting.
- Do not auto-submit when the popup opens.
- Preserve existing PRD queue semantics and payload validation.
- Keep non-PRD chat responses unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A chat-generated PRD no longer forces the manager to use the Advanced tab to review it.
- The manager sees a dedicated popup with a readable visual summary of the proposed PRD.
- Clicking `Submit` queues the PRD through the same backend path used today.
- Clicking `Back`, `Return`, or close exits without creating a PRD.
- A dismissed or closed popup does not submit work accidentally.
- Existing non-PRD chat flows behave the same as before.

## Verification
- Add UI/component tests for popup rendering from a chat `prdProposal`.
- Add tests for submit, back/return, and close behaviors.
- Add an integration-style test proving popup submission still enters the normal PRD queue path.
- Run `npm run typecheck` and relevant control-plane UI/server tests.
